root_cause_analysis.fold_0_and_2_high_performance: Folds 0 and 2 achieved ROC-AUC >= 0.909 and PR-AUC >= 0.766 because their validation partitions contain unambiguous multifocal metastatic lesions (e.g., intense axial and appendicular hot spots) with high signal-to-noise ratio against normal skeletal background. Furthermore, these folds trained for 15-17 epochs without validation loss divergence, allowing deep feature convergence in layer4.
root_cause_analysis.fold_3_and_4_early_stopping: Folds 3 and 4 triggered early stopping at Epoch 7 (best epoch was 2). After Epoch 2, validation loss in Fold 4 climbed from 1.0396 to 1.1878 while PR-AUC stagnated around 0.31-0.33. This indicates early generalization saturation: with only 34 training positive patients, model predictions on challenging isolated/subtle solitary metastasis patients did not improve after 2 epochs, causing the patience counter (5 epochs) to trigger promptly as designed, protecting against severe over-memorization.
root_cause_analysis.early_stopping_behavior: Early stopping functioned precisely as intended by arresting training when validation PR-AUC ceased improving for 5 consecutive epochs, saving checkpoints from the optimal validation epoch and preventing wasteful GPU cycles on diverging validation loss.
